info.title: Mozilla Data Collective API
info.description:
The Mozilla Data Collective REST API.

Some endpoints require an `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create an API key at
https://mozilladatacollective.com/profile/credentials.

servers.description: Base URL for every path below, relative to this document

bearerAuth.description: An API key from Profile → Credentials, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

ApiError.description: Every error response carries a client-safe message under `error`.

limit.description: Deprecated, and only present on the two dataset endpoints that have published it since before the wrapper existed. A 429 from the rate limiter itself carries the message alone. Read the `Retry-After` header instead, which every 429 carries.

fileSize.description: Exact size in bytes of the file being uploaded.

mimeType.description: Must be a gzip or tar media type.

uploadId.description: The storage provider's multipart upload id, as returned when the upload was initiated.

partNumber.description: 1-based index of the part, in the order they were uploaded.

etag.description: The ETag the storage provider returned for that part, quotes included.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the whole assembled file, hex-encoded. Verified server-side before the upload is accepted.

get.description: Returns 200 while the application is serving. Unauthenticated, and does not touch the database.
Retrieves the public summary of a dataset by its ID or URL slug.

schema.description: Dataset ID (a CUID) or URL slug.

post.description: Returns a presigned storage URL. The caller must already satisfy the dataset's access requirements — terms agreement, an approved access request, and payment for a paid dataset. Those are completed in the web interface, not through the API.

402.description: Payment required for this paid dataset

403.description: Terms of use not agreed, or access request not approved

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: download quota reached

post.description: Returns a presigned storage URL for the dataset's public sample file, where one is published.

404.description: Dataset not found, or it publishes no sample

get.description: Croissant 1.0 JSON-LD describing the dataset. Public and unauthenticated, and served with an hour of cache: it exists to be indexed by dataset search engines.

422.description: Valid Croissant metadata could not be produced

post.description: Creates a draft dataset submission for the caller's organization. The organization must be approved to publish datasets.

403.description: Organization is not permitted to create submissions

patch.description: Updates a submission's fields, some fields cannot be updated after approval

post.description: Submits a draft dataset for review

requestBody.description: Confirmation that the submitter agrees to submit

400.description: Submission is incomplete, or agreement was not confirmed

post.description: Starts a multipart upload for a submission's main dataset file.

400.description: Invalid filename, size or MIME type

get.description: Returns a short-lived URL the client PUTs one part directly up to
